_readme: The weekly 36 Principles meeting (Step, Tradition and Concept of the same number, side by side). Set published: true and fill in the details when the meeting is ready to be listed; until then /meeting/ says 'details coming soon' and is left out of the menu and sitemap. The study pages at /principles/ are always public. cycle.mode: 'by-number' (12-week cycle: one number per week, all three legacies that week) or 'by-principle' (36-week cycle: Step 1, Tradition 1, Concept 1, Step 2, …). cycle.startDate: the date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the meeting that studied number 1 (or Step 1); the site works out the current focus from it and the weekly rebuild keeps it current.
name: 36 Principles Meeting
tagline: One number. Three legacies. Every week.
description: A weekly online A.A. meeting that reads the Step, the Tradition and the Concept of the same number together, then shares on how they connect — in our recovery, in our groups, and in service.
format: Open with the Serenity Prayer and the A.A. Preamble.
Read the Step, the Tradition and the Concept of the week (short forms), one reader each.
The chair offers two or three minutes on the thread that connects them (see the study page for that number).
Open sharing, three minutes each, on how that thread shows up in your recovery, your home group and your service.
Seventh Tradition reminder, announcements, and close with the Responsibility Statement.
